endpoints.call: the WordPress job_feed RSS is a usable public feed (note robots.txt disallows /feed/ — use the ?feed=job_feed URL the site itself links, at a gentle cadence)
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. The former Authentic Jobs API (/api/docs) is gone (404); what remains is a WordPress job_listing RSS 2.0 feed (title, link, dc:creator, job_listing:* fields). Terms page (11.4 k chars) has no bot / scraping clause; robots.txt disallows /feed/ and /xmlrpc.php.

search.note: GET https://authenticjobs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings: the WP Job Manager job_listing post type through the WordPress REST API posts controller (arguments page, per_page <= 100, search = WordPress full-text search; the route's own schema is listed at that URL). location and remote are not sent (location is post meta / a region taxonomy, not a query argument). title and description are rendered HTML; company is meta._company_name, location meta._job_location, the apply link meta._application and salary meta._job_salary stay in raw.meta. Only published listings are returned; a page past the end answers 400 rest_post_invalid_page_number (upstream_error). The RSS job feed (?feed=job_feed) carries the same listings.

get_posting.note: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings/<id> with the numeric post id from search; an unknown id answers 404 rest_post_invalid_id (invalid_input).

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify: the WordPress REST API is read publicly and the site offers no job-seeker account API.
not_offered.apply: Applications go to each listing's meta._application (an employer URL or e-mail); the site has no application endpoint.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging endpoint in the site's REST index; only job listings are exposed.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
